source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseLocalRuntimeRequiredDatabase003Test { @isTest static void missingDatabaseThreeContracts() { Database.MergeResult mergeResult = new Database.MergeResult(); mergeResult.errors = new List<Database.Error>(); System.assertEquals(0, mergeResult.errors.size()); Database.NestedSaveResult nested = new Database.NestedSaveResult(); nested.relationshipsaveresults = new List<Database.RelationshipSaveResult>(); System.assert(nested.equals(nested)); System.assertEquals(nested.hashCode(), nested.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, nested.toString()); Database.PaginationCursor pagination = new Database.PaginationCursor(); System.assertNotEquals(null, pagination); System.assertNotEquals(null, pagination.clone()); Database.RelationshipSaveResult relationship = new Database.RelationshipSaveResult(); relationship.relationshipname = 'Contacts'; relationship.saveresults = new List<Database.NestedSaveResult>{nested}; System.assertEquals('Contacts', relationship.relationshipname); System.assertEquals(1, relationship.saveresults.size()); System.assert(relationship.equals(relationship)); System.assertEquals(relationship.hashCode(), relationship.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, relationship.toString()); Database.SaveResult saveResult = new Database.SaveResult(); System.assertNotEquals(null, saveResult); Object savepoint = (Database.Savepoint)null; System.assertEquals(null, savepoint); Database.UndeleteResult undeleteResult = new Database.UndeleteResult(); System.assertNotEquals(null, undeleteResult); Database.UnitOfWork work = new Database.UnitOfWork(); System.assertNotEquals(null, work.clone()); } }
